Outreach (Cluster-association lists + IndiaMART manufacturer profiles): first contact via IndiaMART enquiry or email; WhatsApp only after opt-in. Teaser names “EVA slippers · men” and its gap, with a 5-minute cost-check link.
Cost check: making cost ₹55 → break-even ₹122; list ₹149 vs B ₹165: pass.
Sign-up: manufacturer; GST nature of business and Udyam activity agree → launch-eligible.
Listing bot: first lot 150 units (≈ 14 days of expected sales), price ₹149. Ledger: committed 475/week of 890 unserved.
Fulfilment: at ₹149 the Pack Point fee eats most of your saving; we recommend self-ship for this SKU.
Order book published: “EVA slippers · men” slots, price cap B ₹165, expected 9–12 orders/day (a forecast, not a guarantee); commit by day 7, stock in by day 18, live days 21–25.
Commits 150 units at ₹149 (price locked).
Stock ready: 150 × “EVA slippers, men” linked to the listing.
Factory Launch Week: “EVA slippers, men” live in the launch section (launch districts only) at ₹149.
“EVA slippers, men” is out of stock: out of ranked slots; the page stays up with “notify me”.
Gate 1 (day 30): Tighten. Missed: returns (durability).

g1.rule: Invest if stick rate ≥ 0.5 AND lift ≥ 1.5× AND sell-through ≥ 60% AND prices held AND returns within the category band. Tighten if lift is positive but < 1.5×, or stick rate < 0.5, or durability is short (returns above the band) → fix, rerun once at the next Launch Week. Stop if there is no lift or prices didn’t hold.

guardrails.what: Stick 1.14, lift 2.23×, returns 27.4% → Tighten: fix, rerun once at the next Launch Week
